author: Atdit
body:
Hello Avicadians, and welcome to the official MusicBot Thread!                                                          

You don't know what a MusicBot is?
It's pretty simple. A teamspeak client/bot which is playing music 24/7 (non-stop), in a very good music quality (It's like 1080p at YouTube without pictures, so it does not need a very good internet connection). You can join the MusicBot's channel if you want to listen to the music.

The MusicBot isn't running on the Avicus Teamspeak, because it is being tested and I need to set-up a website to control the music and to see the playlists.

The first official alpha-release will come in the next few months or if I get lucky, weeks.

Music Playlist: [cooming soon]

═════════════════════════════════════════════════
Server specs:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════
CPU: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor E5-2620 (12 cores at 2.5GHz)
RAM: about 8GB DDR3
Connection Down/Up (mbps): 425 (up to 1GBit); 730 (up to 1GBit)
Official unique ID: gUlcsm8z3mM/7UVA+NfuBI1aXZY= and tt4qYrKyxGsgWE6emWbX126MMOI=
Security level : 37 and 39 (mine is 47 :')

═════════════════════════════════════════════════
F.A.Q: (Questions and answers)
═════════════════════════════════════════════════

Q: Where can I see the name of the song which is currently being streamed?
A: Go to [coming soon] 

Q: If the bot isn't running on Avicus yet, where can I find him then?
A: I'm very sure I'm not allowed to post the IP address of the current teamspeakserver, but you can send me an E-Mail if you want the IP to test out the MusicBot. (E-Mail Adress: atdit@atdit.de)

Q: The MusicBot is too loud/softly
A: You can change the volume very easily. Right click the MusicBot and click on 'Change Volume', that's all. Note: +6 dB will make the music quality worse

Q: What can I do if the current music isn't my flavour?
A: The only two 'possible' solutions are, suggest a new song, and hope for it to be voted in, or wait for other music.

Q: Is this bot really 24/7?
A: Actually yes, but it may crash sometimes. But don't worry, the chance of a crash is very low and can be fixed in seconds, after a manager of the musicbot will take a look at it.

═════════════════════════════════════════════════
Screenshots:
═════════════════════════════════════════════════
Screenshots will be available here, after the official release. You can send me screenshots if you will post it here, or email me: atdit@atdit.de
